name: Genius
overview: Scripture reveals that true genius is a divine gift, exemplified by God filling individuals with His Spirit of wisdom, understanding, and knowledge to accomplish skilled workmanship. In Exodus, God specifically calls and equips Bezaleel and Aholiab, along with all wise-hearted craftsmen, to create the intricate and holy items for worship, demonstrating that mechanical skill and creativity originate from God's inspiration and enable faithful service in His purposes.
